summary: verdaccio-okta-oauth ships alternate-runtime dropper: preinstall fetches Bun and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`, which fires automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun JavaScript runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), branching on OS/arch including Alpine musl detection, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line bundle in obfuscator.io style — shuffled string/number array with rotated indexing (`function WV8StW(a,b,c){for(c=0;c<b;c++)a.push(a.shift());return a}`) and mangled `_0xNNNN`/`MmgoCP`/`etDiOOB` identifiers — whose actual behavior is not readable from source. The package presents itself as a Verdaccio Okta OAuth plugin, a role that has no need to download a second language runtime or execute an opaque bundle at install time. Fetching Bun specifically appears designed to run the payload under an interpreter that Node-based install-time scanners do not inspect.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
